spec_evidence.checked: Walked both cached specs: OLD paths contains /accounts/{account_id}/ai/run/@cf/facebook/omni-detr-resnet-50 while NEW does not (path removed); NEW paths contains /accounts/{account_id}/ai/run/@cf/facebook/nonomni-detr-resnet-50 which is absent from OLD — a one-to-one slug rename of the same detr-resnet-50 model route within the corridor window (omni- prefix replaced by nonomni-).

alternative_data_source: the same model remains served at /accounts/{account_id}/ai/run/@cf/facebook/nonomni-detr-resnet-50

fix.migration_guide: Mechanical slug rewrite at every call site that runs this Workers AI model: replace the removed model slug '@cf/facebook/omni-detr-resnet-50' with the canonical slug '@cf/facebook/nonomni-detr-resnet-50' in the ai/run URL (raw fetch callers) or in the model-name argument passed to env.AI.run / the SDK ai.run helper. Request and response schemas for the canonical route are unchanged between the two specs, so no payload edits are needed; this is a one-token rename per call site.
